<title level="2" right="Creature 12">[Gurglegut](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2810)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=723" />
<trait label="NE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 54

**Perception** +23; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Goblin](/Languages.aspx?ID=6), [Sylvan](/Languages.aspx?ID=10)

**Skills**
[Alcohol Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +22, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +20, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +25, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +22, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +23

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +4

**Con** +5

**Int** +4

**Wis** +5

**Cha** +4
</row>

**Items**
_+1 striking [flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2838) [crossbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=425)_ (10 bolts), jug of rice wine, _+1 striking [kukri](/Weapons.aspx?ID=413)_, _+1 resilient [studded leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=42)_

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 32 

**Fort** +23 

**Ref** +20 

**Will** +23 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 216

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_kukri_ +26 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)),
**Damage** 2d6+13 slashing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_crossbow_ +23 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus 1d6 fire

**Command Onidoshi** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** Gurglegut barks out a command to a single onidoshi in area D1. That onidoshi can use a reaction to attempt a melee Strike against an adjacent foe.

**Spit Fire** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** Gurglegut drinks the contents of his jug of rice wine (consuming one of the gulps contained in his jug), then spews it out across the flaming tip of a bolt in his crossbow, filling a 20-foot-cone with a blast of fire that inflicts 10d8 fire damage (DC 32 basic Reflex save) to all creatures in the area.

</column>
